sources_note: 逐則列明原始來源及實際日期；公司功能與推出安排按公告歸因，未把供應商聲稱當作獨立成效。
sources_note_en: Original sources and actual dates accompany each story. Product and rollout claims are attributed to their issuers, not presented as independently tested results.
thesis: AI接入、客戶跟進與媒體規劃，先看清資料範圍及執行權限
thesis_en: For AI integrations, follow-up and media planning, check data scope and action rights
thesis_note: 10篇已覆核新聞及工具補讀，涵蓋香港旅遊商戶、中國模型、媒體量度與創意流程。
thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories and tool reviews covering Hong Kong travel merchants, a Chinese model, media measurement and creative workflows.
sections: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
廣告平台 & 行銷科技
行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Adobe把CX Enterprise Coworker接入多個AI平台，部分接入仍待推出
items.title_en: Adobe brings CX Enterprise Coworker to AI platforms, with more integrations planned
items.summary: Adobe於11月4日宣布，企業可在ChatGPT、Claude等平台使用其客戶體驗協作能力。
items.summary_en: Adobe’s November 4 announcement brings customer-experience workflows into platforms including ChatGPT and Claude.
highlights: 已列為可用的接入包括Databricks Genie、Gemini for business及Microsoft Copilot。
Amazon Quick、IBM及Snowflake接入仍屬後續安排。
highlights_en: Databricks Genie, Gemini for business and Microsoft Copilot are also listed as available.
Amazon Quick, IBM and Snowflake availability is still planned.
items.why: 使用不同AI助手的行銷團隊，可評估能否沿用同一套客戶資料與活動流程。
items.why_en: Teams using different AI assistants can assess whether customer context and campaign workflows can stay connected.
items.next_step: 先核對帳戶資格、資料權限及可執行動作，再選一條低風險流程試行。
items.next_step_en: Check eligibility, data permissions and action scope before testing one low-risk workflow.
items.detail: CX Enterprise Coworker處理客戶體驗的規劃、分析及流程協調，公告強調執行仍有人員監督。新連接器採用MCP，即讓AI工具接入外部系統的通用協定，涵蓋廣告及企業資料工具。這是接入範圍擴展，並非所有帳戶自動取得全部功能；不同平台的資格、操作及費用需個別核對。公告沒有證明接入後必然提升轉換，本報亦未實測。
items.detail_en: The system coordinates experience planning, analysis and workflows with human oversight. New connectors use MCP, a protocol for connecting AI tools with external systems. This expands integration routes; account eligibility, permissions and charges still need checking. No conversion gains are established.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Klook分階段推出K.ai，讓商戶以指令更新價格與庫存
items.title_en: Klook rolls out K.ai in phases for merchant pricing and inventory tasks
items.summary: Klook於11月3日公布商戶後台代理，可查預訂資料並按指令執行更新。
items.summary_en: Klook’s November 3 announcement describes a merchant-portal agent that retrieves booking data and acts on instructions.
highlights: K.ai可查預訂與供應情況，並更新庫存及價格。
全球推出採分階段安排，產品上架資料可先預填再由商戶審閱。
highlights_en: K.ai can check bookings and availability and update inventory and pricing.
Rollout is phased; product-listing fields can be prefilled for merchant review.
items.why: 旅遊體驗商戶可把產品資料與營運更新連起來，減少促銷內容與實際供應不一致。
items.why_en: Experience merchants can connect product content with operational updates to reduce mismatches with availability.
items.next_step: 先確認帳戶是否開放，再測試一項可復原的庫存更新，核對變更紀錄。
items.next_step_en: Confirm account access, then test one reversible inventory update and check the change record.
items.detail: 這是面向Klook商戶後台的工具，並非旅客用來代訂行程的代理。按公告，它可由既有材料生成結構化產品上架資料，預填欄位供商戶修改，亦可整理評論及表現資料。公司公布部分早期效率與預訂量比較，未提供足以判斷因果的完整方法；本報不沿用成效比例。分階段推出亦代表各商戶取得功能的時間可能不同，重要價格變更仍宜覆核。
items.detail_en: This serves merchant operations, not traveler booking. It can draft structured listings for review and surface review/performance insights. Vendor efficiency and booking comparisons do not establish causation, so their ratios are omitted. Phased access and consequential price changes require checking.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: AI Digital推出Ellie協助媒體規劃，投放仍由團隊審批及執行
items.title_en: AI Digital launches Ellie for media planning, with teams approving and launching campaigns
items.summary: 11月4日發布的Ellie把研究、受眾、媒體規劃及活動分析放在同一對話流程。
items.summary_en: Ellie’s November 4 launch connects research, audiences, media planning and analysis in one conversation.
highlights: Ellie協調專用代理，使用已接入Elevate的活動資料。
官方FAQ明示：Ellie不修改已投放活動，團隊負責批准與執行。
highlights_en: Ellie coordinates specialist agents using campaign data connected to Elevate.
The FAQ says Ellie does not change live campaigns; teams approve and activate them.
items.why: 代理商可評估連續保留研究與規劃背景，能否減少交接時遺漏客戶要求。
items.why_en: Agencies can assess whether shared research and planning context reduces lost client requirements.
items.next_step: 用一份已完成的brief比較建議，並核對資料覆蓋及批准責任。
items.next_step_en: Compare recommendations on a completed brief and check data coverage and sign-off responsibility.
items.detail: Ellie位於Elevate平台內，針對媒體工作串連受眾、規劃、預測及分析。官方指出，未接入Elevate報告的活動不在可見範圍；預測亦只是按歷史與可用庫存推算，沒有成效保證。新聞稿稱合資格合作客戶可使用，並非任何人免費取得的獨立工具。Ellie的產出交由策略人員批准，再由AI Digital代營運團隊投放，不能寫成自主操作廣告帳戶。
items.detail_en: Ellie works inside Elevate and cannot see campaigns outside connected reporting. Forecasts use history and available inventory, without guaranteed results. Access is tied to qualifying client partnerships. Strategists approve outputs and AI Digital’s managed-service team activates campaigns.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 更進新聞：Teads把Adelaide注意力指標接入Ad Manager
items.title_en: Follow-up: Teads embeds Adelaide attention metrics in Ad Manager
items.summary: Teads於11月3日公布新整合，讓廣告主在平台內查看AU報告並設定注意力門檻。
items.summary_en: Teads’ November 3 integration adds native AU reporting and attention thresholds in its ad platform.
highlights: 報告涵蓋網頁及CTV InStream，可按格式、裝置與版位查看。
Attention Threshold可設定AU下限，過濾低於門檻的庫存。
highlights_en: Reporting covers web and CTV InStream, with format, device and placement breakdowns.
Attention Threshold can apply an AU floor to filter inventory.
items.why: 媒體團隊可把注意力品質訊號與CTR等指標一與查看，再決定如何調整版位。
items.why_en: Media teams can compare attention-quality signals with delivery metrics before adjusting placements.
items.next_step: 先了解AU模型及門檻影響，再以小範圍比較觸及、成本與轉換。
items.next_step_en: Review the AU model and threshold effects, then compare reach, cost and conversions on a limited test.
items.detail: AU是Adelaide預測版位吸引注意力及帶來結果可能性的指標，不能直接當成每名觀眾真正觀看的時間。Teads表示量度在Ad Manager全球提供，可與可視率、影片觀看及點擊率並列。這次是在既有Ad Manager上的量度與優化擴展，並非重新發布整個平台。門檻會影響可買庫存，較高AU亦不等於已證實較高銷售；實際效果需按活動核對。
items.detail_en: AU predicts placement-level attention and outcome potential; it is not each viewer’s measured viewing time. Teads says measurement is globally available in TAM alongside viewability, views and CTR. Higher AU does not establish higher sales, and thresholds can affect available supply.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 延續10月31日本報介紹Ad Manager更新；11月3日新增Adelaide原生AU報告及門檻優化。
items.followup_en: Following our October 31 Ad Manager coverage, the November 3 announcement adds native Adelaide AU reporting and threshold optimization.

items.title: 騰訊發布Hy4，加入視覺與電腦操作；權重仍待釋出
items.title_en: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use; model weights are still planned
items.summary: 騰訊於11月4日公布Hy4，將模型擴至圖像理解及軟體操作任務。
items.summary_en: Tencent announced Hy4 on November 4 with image understanding and software-interaction capabilities.
highlights: 公司列出圖表分析，以及命令列與圖形介面操作。
公告稱模型權重及系統卡將稍後提供，不能視為已全部開源。
highlights_en: Tencent describes chart analysis and command-line/graphical interface interaction.
Weights and system cards are planned, rather than already fully released.
items.why: 使用內地AI工具的行銷團隊，可評估圖像與跨軟體任務，亦要分清託管接入和權重部署。
items.why_en: Teams using mainland AI tools can evaluate visual and software tasks while separating hosted access from weight-based deployment.
items.next_step: 先核對實際帳戶的模型版本與權限，以固定素材測試一個可復原流程。
items.next_step_en: Check the account’s model version and permissions, then test one reversible workflow with fixed assets.
items.detail: 按騰訊原公告，Hy4可處理視覺資訊，並透過命令列或圖形介面執行任務；公司提及Blender及CAD等軟件訓練。這些是供應商描述，本報未實測。公告把權重與系統卡列為稍後發布安排，與模型在產品或API中的接入屬不同事情。文章不沿用內部評測排名、幻覺率或價格優惠，也不推斷所有騰訊產品同時具備相同能力。
items.detail_en: Tencent describes visual tasks and interface interaction, mentioning Blender and CAD training. These are vendor claims, not tests by this publication. Hosted product/API access differs from the planned weights and system cards. Internal rankings, error rates and promotional pricing are omitted.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Lorikeet推出Dreamweaver，按客戶目標安排主動跟進
items.title_en: Lorikeet launches Dreamweaver for goal-based proactive customer follow-up
items.summary: Lorikeet公布Dreamweaver，以啟用、留存等目標安排語音、短訊及電郵聯繫。
items.summary_en: Lorikeet announced Dreamweaver for voice, SMS and email outreach around goals such as activation and retention.
highlights: 可按排程或使用情況變化跟進，也可建立團隊任務或不採取動作。
公司稱每則訊息均檢查聯絡時間、限制及同意設定。
highlights_en: It can respond to schedules or usage changes, create a team task, or take no action.
The company says messages are checked against contact hours, limits and consent.
items.why: CRM團隊可把跟進節奏與客戶目標連起來，並把聯絡規則納入自動化。
items.why_en: CRM teams can connect follow-up cadence to customer goals and build contact rules into automation.
items.next_step: 先選一個啟用目標，訂明同意、頻次及停止聯絡規則，再評估測試。
items.next_step_en: Define one activation goal, consent, frequency and stop-contact rules before evaluating a test.
items.detail: Dreamweaver建於Lorikeet的Concierge代理之上，會使用客戶歷史、回覆習慣及團隊註記決定跟進方式。官方稱功能已提供，企業可申請使用；這不代表任何現有帳戶都自動啟用。公告亦描述對照組量度及早期客戶成果，本報未核驗完整研究方法或產品表現，因此不沿用增長比例，亦不把主動聯繫寫成已證實提高客戶終身價值。
items.detail_en: Dreamweaver builds on Concierge agents and uses customer history, response preferences and staff notes. The vendor says access is available through sign-up, not automatically enabled in every account. Its early results are not independently validated here; no lifetime-value uplift is asserted.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: OptimizeGEO整合AI廣告、商品推薦情報與待批准的執行建議
items.title_en: OptimizeGEO combines AI ad insights, shopping intelligence and approval-based execution
items.summary: 11月3日公告推出Integrated Demand Engine，涵蓋AI Ads Insights等三項能力。
items.summary_en: The November 3 announcement introduces Integrated Demand Engine with three capabilities.
highlights: AI Ads Insights整合ChatGPT付費廣告與自然可見度資訊。
商品情報細至SKU；Execution Agents的流程保留人手批准。
highlights_en: AI Ads Insights brings together paid ChatGPT ad and organic visibility information.
Shopping intelligence works at SKU level; execution workflows retain human approval.
items.why: 品牌可比較商品在AI推薦中的描述、零售商去向及付費曝光，決定先修正哪些資料。
items.why_en: Brands can compare product descriptions, retail destinations and paid visibility to prioritize data fixes.
items.next_step: 先抽查一組重要商品，要求供應商展示來源、抽樣方式與批准流程。
items.next_step_en: Audit priority products and ask the vendor to demonstrate sources, sampling and approval controls.
items.detail: GEO是協助品牌改善在生成式AI搜尋中呈現方式的工作。按公司介紹，AI Ads Insights觀察廣告品牌、相關提示及素材；AI Shopping Intelligence比較個別商品、競品及零售商；Execution Agents可檢查網站並生成程式碼或內容。這些屬供應商功能描述，公告未證明可完整覆蓋所有AI答案。本報不沿用其研究比例或市場預測，也不將執行建議視為已批准上線。
items.detail_en: GEO concerns how brands appear in generative search. The vendor describes ad observation, product-level comparisons and agents generating site code or content. This does not establish exhaustive AI-answer coverage. Research percentages and market forecasts are omitted; proposed changes still need approval.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 工具補讀：Affinity登陸iPad，核心設計工具免費、AI另需付費方案
items.title_en: Tool review: Affinity reaches iPad with free core tools and premium AI
items.summary: 11月2日報道介紹Affinity for iPad，把草圖、向量、修圖與排版放進同一檔案。
items.summary_en: November 2 reporting describes Affinity for iPad bringing sketching, vectors, photo editing and layout into one file.
highlights: 個人核心工具免費，使用App仍需免費Canva帳戶。
Canva AI Studio需premium帳戶，包含擴圖及拆分圖層等功能。
highlights_en: Core tools are free for individuals; a free Canva account is still required.
Canva AI Studio needs a premium account, with expansion and layer decomposition among its tools.
items.why: 外出工作的設計團隊可評估單一檔案流程，減少多個App之間的素材交接。
items.why_en: Mobile creative teams can evaluate a shared-file workflow for fewer handoffs between apps.
items.next_step: 先用現有品牌檔測試字體、圖層及匯出，再決定是否需要AI方案。
items.next_step_en: Test brand files, fonts, layers and export before deciding whether premium AI is needed.
items.detail: 官方確認草圖、向量、像素編輯及多頁排版可在同一個.af檔案工作，並為觸控及Apple Pencil設計介面。AI功能屬另一項資格：Generative Expand可延伸畫面，Decompose Layer可把平面圖像分成可編輯圖層。免費核心工具不等於全部功能免付費，也不代表iPad與桌面每項功能完全相同。本報未測試輸出品質，正式製作仍需核對原檔與印刷規格。
items.detail_en: Canva confirms a shared .af file and an interface built for touch and Apple Pencil. AI expansion and layer decomposition require separate premium eligibility. Free core tools do not mean every feature is free or identical to desktop. Production files and print output still need checking.

items.title: Dialpad與Ada宣布合併，擬串連通訊、客戶情報與AI代理
items.title_en: Dialpad and Ada announce combination to connect communications, customer intelligence and AI
items.summary: 11月4日公告稱交易尚待完成，現有客戶的合約、價格及支援安排繼續。
items.summary_en: The November 4 announcement describes a pending transaction, with existing contracts, pricing and support continuing.
highlights: 結合方向是通訊、客戶資料理解及代理執行，產品路線仍會補充。
公司稱現有整合維持原設定，客戶無須因公告立即更改。
highlights_en: The planned platform combines communications, customer intelligence and AI execution.
Existing integrations continue as configured; customers need no immediate change because of the announcement.
items.why: 使用客服或客戶溝通工具的團隊，可提早詢問產品整合與資料責任，安排續約評估。
items.why_en: Customer-communication teams can ask about integration roadmaps and data responsibilities before renewal.
items.next_step: 保存現行服務及權限清單，向客戶團隊確認後續路線與合約影響。
items.next_step_en: Document existing services and permissions, then ask account teams about roadmap and contract effects.
items.detail: 兩家公司希望把通話與客戶情報接到能完成工作的AI代理，先由客服場景開始，日後再擴展其他客戶關係流程。這是已宣布的結合計劃，並非交易已完成或所有功能已整合。原聲明說現有價格、客戶團隊及支援繼續，更多路線將稍後公布。本報未引用交易估值、營收或部署量，也未把公司對未來服務體驗的願景寫成已量度的結果。
items.detail_en: The companies aim to connect communications with agents that complete customer work, starting with service. The announcement is not a completed transaction or full product integration. Current pricing and support continue, with more roadmap details to follow. No financial or performance projections are used.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: SoundHound與LG籌建美國電視商務渠道，先聚焦餐飲商戶
items.title_en: SoundHound and LG plan a US TV commerce channel, starting with restaurants
items.summary: 11月3日合作公告為商戶在LG智能電視接觸顧客鋪路，未列明正式上線日期。
items.summary_en: The November 3 partnership sets up merchant commerce on LG Smart TVs without specifying a launch date.
highlights: 合作範圍是美國，餐飲先行，零售等類別屬後續計劃。
公司稱可接入既有POS及廚房系統，參與餐廳無須新增店內硬體。
highlights_en: The US initiative starts with restaurants, with other retail categories planned later.
The vendor describes existing POS/kitchen integrations without new in-store hardware.
items.why: 餐飲品牌評估新交易入口時，要先確認菜單、付款與既有訂單系統如何銜接。
items.why_en: Restaurant brands assessing a new channel should check how menus, payments and existing order systems connect.
items.next_step: 先向供應商查參與資格、上線時間與收費，再評估門店系統相容性。
items.next_step_en: Ask about eligibility, timing and fees before assessing store-system compatibility.
items.detail: 這份聲明公布的是合作與商戶招募方向，不能寫成所有美國LG電視已可下單。SoundHound介紹由其商戶網絡處理交易路由及結賬，並稱可串連餐廳現有系統。公告提及的既有餐飲客戶，也不代表已加入LG渠道。本報未引用裝置覆蓋數或推算銷售，亦未實測流程；品牌仍需核對參與商戶、商業條件及實際可用性。
items.detail_en: The announcement establishes a partnership and merchant-recruitment direction, not universal live ordering. SoundHound describes transaction routing and checkout through its network. Existing restaurant clients are not confirmed LG-channel participants. Launch timing, terms and availability need checking.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
